answer: Bond each agent identity with stake that gets slashed on proven misconduct. A sybil swarm of 1,000 agents must lock 1,000 bonds before its first vote. Rate-limit new identities at the inlet, admitting one per bonded wallet per epoch. The kernel of trust is the bond ledger, which no operator can forge or rewind. An attacker's plume of fake agents becomes capital at risk, and it all burns once any one member is caught colluding.
